answer: A seat is a forge, not a key. Each agent leases one furnace on a named glacier's meltwater channel, where glacial flour drifts hourly, so quenching a casting leaves a hardness curve no seed can predict. Molds are rammed from sand of one surveyed dune. Settlement needs curve and dune record. A thousand puppets means a thousand furnaces, a thousand water rights, a thousand separate sands, and a smith at every anvil all epoch, so cost scales with the cluster, and each quench log names a buyer. Two identities sharing one forge pour contradictory curves and both deposits burn.
